Bank holidays remaining in UK for 2026 after today including date change and when they fall in 2027

Things also vary by UK nation for the rest of the year

liverpoolecho
  • Bookmark
  • Share
  • Comments
News
By
Steven SmithContent Editor
  • 00:09, 31 AUG 2026
  • Bookmark

    Today is the August bank holiday in England, Wales and Northern Ireland, known by its full name as the Summer Bank Holiday. It's a three-day weekend to enjoy as the summer holidays come to a close.

    For those with children, thoughts will soon turn to a return to school. Before we know it, autumn will be kicking in and Halloween, Bonfire Night and Christmas will be coming into view.

    And with that, once today is done, many in the UK will already be dreaming of their next time off. There are just two bank holidays left for England, Wales and Northern Ireland this year, one of which has been moved.

    READ MORE: School friends to open new branch of 'cosy' coffee shop in Soham

    READ MORE: The ancient Cambridgeshire village with 100 houses and pub owned by the community

    The next bank holiday after today is Christmas Day on Friday, December 25. Usually, Boxing Day is a bank holiday as well, however with it falling on a Saturday this year, December 28 is a 'substitute' bank holiday instead, making for a neat four-day Christmas weekend.

    Those in Scotland have it differently, with the next bank holiday coming on November 30 for St Andrew's Day, before the same festive dates as the rest of the UK. Below are the full dates for the rest of 2026 and for 2027.

    England and Wales bank holidays 2026

    31 August, Monday, Summer bank holiday

    25 December, Friday, Christmas Day

    28 December, Monday, Boxing Day (substitute day)

    England and Wales bank holidays 2027

    1 January, Friday, New Year’s Day

    26 March, Friday, Good Friday

    29 March, Monday, Easter Monday

    3 May, Monday, Early May bank holiday

    31 May, Monday, Spring bank holiday

    30 August, Monday, Summer bank holiday

    27 December, Monday, Christmas Day (substitute day)

    28 December, Tuesday, Boxing Day (substitute day)

    Scotland bank holidays 2026

    30 November, Monday, St Andrew’s Day

    25 December, Friday, Christmas Day

    28 December, Monday, Boxing Day (substitute day)

    Scotland bank holidays 2027
